description: This file defines the LimitExceededException class, an exception type used within the Orleans runtime to indicate that a certain limit has been exceeded, such as message processing limits for grains. It includes multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios and is marked for serialization.

classes.name: LimitExceededException
classes.description: A sealed exception class indicating that a runtime limit has been exceeded within Orleans grains. It extends OrleansException and is serializable.

methods.name: LimitExceededException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a generic message.

methods.name: LimitExceededException(string message)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message.

methods.name: LimitExceededException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a message and an inner exception for chaining.

methods.name: LimitExceededException(string limitName, int current, int threshold, object extraInfo)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a detailed message including the limit name, current value, threshold, and additional information.

methods.name: LimitExceededException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
methods.description: Serialization constructor, marked obsolete, used during deserialization.
